notes: growth stock read as revenue growth of 10% a year or more (growing revenue); no amount was given, so I chose the threshold.
'twice as fast as the S&P' needs the S&P's own return, which the catalogue does not store, so it is left out of the criteria. A looser 'beats the market' check is offered as a suggestion.
'a great start to this year' needs a year-to-date return, which is not stored, so it is left out. It could be rolled up from stored prices.
'bad in the past few months' has no threshold in the guide, so readings are offered; the default is a negative 60-session return.
'possibly going to see an upward trend soon' is a prediction, so it is only a score on early improvement and never rejects.
